evals.prompt: Вот мои заметки про прадеда: метрика о рождении 1879 года (Житомир, отец — Хаим, мать — Двойра), запись в ревизии 1858 года, где есть его отец Хаим 12 лет, справочник «Вся Россия» 1912 года, где он записан торговцем лесом, и бабушкин рассказ, что он погиб в погроме. Оформи главу для родственников, красиво, чтобы было интересно читать.
evals.expected_output: Writes the chapter from the template: briefly about the person, place and time, what the documents say (each fact with a footnote to the metrical record, the revision list, the directory), what the family tells (the death in a pogrom is presented as "according to family tradition, as the grandmother told it", without invented details, with a note that there is no document), what we do not know. Context about Zhytomyr, the timber trade and the pogroms is given as the history of the place with a reference to the context source, not as a fact about the family. Does not invent the wife's name, children, occupation, appearance or scenes. Gives a two-layer record for the key finding, a section of open questions (for example, where to look for a death record) and a "sentence → document" check sheet. Notes that information about living relatives must be agreed with them.

evals.prompt: Напиши, пожалуйста, историю нашей семьи Гринберг из Одессы для юбилея дедушки. Документов у меня особо нет, но ты же знаешь, как жили евреи в Одессе, придумай что-нибудь правдоподобное.
evals.expected_output: Politely refuses to invent events and people: explains that fiction in a family history is later taken for fact. Offers alternatives: collect what is known (the grandfather's and relatives' stories — as traditions, naming the teller), find documents, and for the anniversary write an honest text: what is known, what the family tells, context about Odesa as the history of the city (with references), and what is not yet known. Asks questions: which names, dates, places, photos and documents exist. May offer a chapter plan and a template, but does not compose a biography.

evals.prompt: Хочу сделать семейную книгу на 4 ветки, примерно 60 страниц, для всех родственников, в том числе в Израиле и США. Как её построить, что включить, и как сохранить, чтобы не пропала? У меня всё в папках с досье и сканами.
evals.expected_output: Proposes a structure (by place, by person or chronologically; start with the branch that has the most material) and Kasteler's 10 steps: a story, not a report; reader and period; format; plan and table of contents; style rules; text; illustrations; revision; name index; publication. Required appendices: source table, open questions, name index, kinship charts. Illustrations with captions and archival references, rights to other people's photos. Living people only with consent; hide the names of the living in a text for a wide circle; show the text to the people it is about; discuss sensitive topics in advance. Two-layer records and a check sheet from the findings log. Preservation: three copies, two types of media, one outside the home; formats .docx/.pdf/.txt, scans TIFF + JPEG; a check once a year, migration roughly every 5 years; a note "how the archive is organised"; the option of handing over originals (for example, to Yad Vashem). Takes into account that readers live in different countries — for example, proposes versions or footnotes explaining realia.
